summary.text: Kristina Moorhead is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican John Ruckelshaus.
A policy analyst and former Indiana Medicaid policy official, she won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Kristina Moorhead graduated from New Palestine High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Ball State University in 2005 and a graduate degree from Indiana University in 2008.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said a debate tournament at Ball State sparked her interest in public policy and that she earned a Master's in Public Affairs from Indiana University-Indianapolis.
She said she went on to serve in state government, including as Deputy Director of the Indiana Office of Medicaid Policy and Planning.
Moorhead described herself as a lifelong Hoosier, a wife and a mother of three, and listed affordability among her campaign's key messages.
She defeated Demetrice Hicks, David Greene and Kevin Short in the 2026 Democratic primary.
